scope: Passive logged-out public feed, 7-9 Oct 2026, Towers entries only. Raw units; scale unverified. Selected by game name, not a complete record of Towers activity (see collection gaps). Not used for any aggregate or site-wide estimate.
rule: unique (difficulty,row) with |payout - stake*step^row| < 1 raw unit; then payout == floor(stake*step^row)

precision_test.note: truncated_kdp = the exact compounded multiplier truncated to k decimals before multiplying; client_js_label_3dp = the label the captured client computes in JavaScript. Truncation at 6 or more decimals reproduces the same values as the full multiplier here, so the exact internal precision is not uniquely established; the 3-decimal ladder is ruled out.
